blocks.label: Dialogue
blocks.text:
A: 기사님, 서울역으로 가 주세요.
B: 네. 여기에서 출발합니다.

blocks.label: Focus
blocks.text: 기사님은 택시 기사에게 가장 자연스러운 호칭입니다. '~으로 가 주세요'는 목적지를 말할 때 가장 많이 사용하는 표현입니다.

blocks.label: Summary
blocks.text:
기사님
~으로 가 주세요
여기에서 내려 주세요
카드 돼요?

title: At work: asking someone to repeat
subtitle: Workplace · clarification · polite request

blocks.label: Dialogue
blocks.text:
A: 이건 오늘까지 끝내 주세요.
B: 죄송하지만, 다시 한번 말씀해 주세요.

blocks.label: Focus
blocks.text: ‘다시 한번’ softens the request and frames it as one more attempt. ‘말씀’ raises the other person's speech politely.

blocks.label: Summary
blocks.text: Useful when instructions were unclear. You can reuse the same form in offices, hospitals, and public services.

title: At a restaurant: checking an order
subtitle: Restaurant · ordering · confirmation

blocks.label: Dialogue
blocks.text:
A: 이거 매운 거 맞아요?
B: 네, 조금 매워요.

blocks.label: Focus
blocks.text: ‘맞아요?’ asks whether the listener confirms an assumption already in the speaker's mind.

blocks.label: Summary
blocks.text: Useful for confirming food, locations, names, schedules, and prices.

blocks.label: Notice
blocks.text: 덥네요.

blocks.label: Realize
blocks.text: 덥구나!

blocks.label: Insist
blocks.text: 덥다니까!

blocks.label: Hidden thought
blocks.text: The event is the same. What changes is the speaker's stance toward it.

blocks.label: Positive
blocks.text: 좋아요.

blocks.label: Negative
blocks.text: 나빠요.

blocks.label: Context
blocks.text: These words evaluate things, conditions, decisions, health, weather, and many other topics.

title: 예쁘다 / 아름답다
subtitle: Similar meaning, different scope and tone

blocks.label: 예쁘다
blocks.text: 예뻐요.

blocks.label: 아름답다
blocks.text: 아름다워요.

blocks.label: Difference
blocks.text: 예쁘다 is common and everyday. 아름답다 is broader and often more elevated or literary.

blocks.label: Situation
blocks.text: 비가 와요.

blocks.label: Likely action
blocks.text: 우산을 가져가요.

blocks.label: Why it matters
blocks.text: This section connects words through ordinary expectations rather than dictionary definitions alone.

title: 손이 크다
subtitle: To prepare or give more than expected

blocks.label: Expression
blocks.text: 우리 어머니는 손이 커요.

blocks.label: Meaning
blocks.text: She tends to prepare a lot, especially food. It does not literally describe hand size.

blocks.label: Scene
blocks.text: A meal for three people becomes enough food for ten.

blocks.label: Status
blocks.text: This space is reserved. V2 does not force a premature category before the learning idea is clear.
